name: CG · 10 Gemini Text
description: Gateway sub-workflow for Gemini text generation: primary model with retry, fallback model, deadline-aware timeouts, JSON-schema output parsing, usage and cost tracking. Never throws on model failure.

options.timeout: ={{ Math.max(3000, Math.min($("Prepare Gemini Request").first().json.timeout_ms, $("Prepare Gemini Request").first().json.deadline_at - $now.toMillis() - 2000)) }}

parameters.content:
## Gemini Text gateway
Every text call in the content pipeline goes through here, so model choice, timeouts, retries, fallback and cost tracking live in one place.

**Input (1 item):** purpose, models {primary, fallback}, system, prompt, response_schema (optional JSON Schema), temperature, max_output_tokens, thinking_level, timeout_ms, deadline_at (epoch ms), pricing, simulate_primary_fail, passthrough.

**Output:** ok, text, data (parsed JSON when a schema is given), model, fallback_used, usage, cost_usd, latency_ms, attempts[], error, passthrough.

Never throws on model failures: callers branch on `ok`.

### Resilience
- Each call retries once after 2 s (transient 429/5xx).
- HTTP errors leave through the error output; empty, truncated or invalid-JSON answers fail the parse step. Both paths go to the fallback model.
- Timeout = min(timeout_ms, time left before deadline_at), so a slow call cannot push the run past the 5-minute budget.

nodeGroups.name: Primary model
nodeGroups.description: Builds the Gemini request, calls the primary model (1 retry) and validates the answer. Anything not OK goes on to the fallback.

nodeGroups.name: Fallback model
nodeGroups.description: Calls the fallback model with the same request and validates its answer the same way.
